significance: Provides an all-rank strictness classification and equality case for one column and reproducible proofs of restricted cases of the type B parity log-concavity conjecture.
prior_work: Sagan and Swanson, q-Stirling numbers in type B (doi:10.1016/j.ejc.2023.103899), give the recurrences in Definition 1.5, symmetric-function formulas in Theorem 2.1, and the parity question in Conjecture 7.5. Their Theorem 7.2 and Corollary 7.3 compare polynomials across columns. The inequalities here compare coefficients within a fixed polynomial. Bottom-heaviness (Conjecture 7.6) compares reflected degrees, and asymptotic normality (Conjecture 7.8) describes a limiting distribution. This note consolidates the project’s proofs from GitHub releases v1.0.0 and v1.3.0 and makes no claim of discovery priority.
